model_annotation: Understanding the trends and performance in scenarios that involve distillation methods is crucial in machine learning. The bar plots provided give us insight into the inference time, which is an important metric for assessing the efficiency of these models. The plots show the inference time for different models, plotting the time against various batch sizes. The first plot, labeled "1B Models," displays three sets of bars, each representing a different model configuration: Llama-1B, Llama-IB, and MambaIn.llama-1B. These settings vary by the number of layers and the batch size, with the batch size plotted on the x-axis in 1s and the inference time in 10s. Each model configuration has bars of a unique color, aiding in distinguishing between them. The second plot, labeled "3B Models," mirrors the first plot's format but includes configurations of the Llama-3B with varied batch sizes. The inference time for these configurations ranges from 0.2 to 30 seconds, as indicated on the y-axis. The bars in these plots also differ in color and seem to indicate the model's performance over different batch sizes. The overall trends in these plots, such as how inference time varies with batch size, can provide valuable insights into model scalability and efficiency.
